items.name: grid-background
items.title: Grid Background
items.description: A blueprint grid that fades toward the edges. Line colour derives from your --foreground token, so it works in both modes.

items.name: aurora-background
items.title: Aurora Background
items.description: Three slow-drifting colour fields behind your content. Honours prefers-reduced-motion.
